📰 Why Deleting a File Doesn't Erase It (NIST Standard)

When you delete a file on your computer, the underlying data remains fully intact on your storage drive. This guide explores the file system mechanics, flash memory complexities, and the NIST SP 800-88 sanitization tiers required to securely erase sensitive data.
